status_code_note: *** THE GH #408 DATA POINT WAS LOST, AND THE LOSS IS STRUCTURAL, NOT A SKIPPED STEP. An on-demand machine has NO spot instance request, so the SIR channel that carries a spot machine's Status.Code past the describe-instances window does not exist for it. Its ONLY evidence channel is EC2 describe-instances, which keeps a terminated instance ~1h (GH #375). This machine launched 12:18:43Z, shipped its last game at 13:10:53Z and self-terminated shortly after; the harvesting round ran at 15:2xZ (the 14:xxZ trigger produced no report), i.e. ~2h later, and BOTH censuses came back EMPTY (pending/running: 0 rows; terminated,shutting-down: 0 rows, exit 0 on each). So ec2_state_reason_code cannot be recovered for this machine, ever. *** Consequence worth naming: GH #408's on-demand re-run path has a STRICTLY SHORTER evidence half-life than the spot path it replaces -- spot keeps SIR, on-demand keeps nothing -- so its status_code must be captured within ~1h of termination or it is gone. The desk did not have a round inside that window.
